divine. [Canticle of] the Canticle of Canticles [Harts] Tone 4 [d2]: "To You, O God" (Ar kez astuats).
Magnificat [Metsatsustse]: "Of the Patriarchs" (Nahapetatsn). Mercy [Voghormea] and Lord of Heaven [Ter-yerknits] of the Prophets, say Tone 3 [d3]: "Who brings good tidings" (Or avetavor), and "Today the nations" (Aysor zhoghovurdq). Midday [Mankunq] Tone 4 [d4]: "Today rejoices, being glad" (Aysor tsndtsay zuarchatsyal).
Midday Introit: "Lord, who established" (Ter or himnetsutser).
Hymn Tone 1 [ad]: "Ray of light" (Charagayt).
Psalm 76 [77]: "You led like sheep" (Arachnortetser vorpes khashin).
Book of Genesis 4:1: "Adam knew Eve..." to 50:26: "...in a coffin in Egypt." [This is a selected reading].
Book of Numbers 20:23: "And the Lord spoke..." to verse 30: "...the house of Israel."
Book of Deuteronomy 34:5: "And Moses died..." to verse 12: "...of the children of Israel."
Book of Joshua 24:29: "And Israel served..." to verse 33: "...in the hill of Ephraim."
Book of 1 Samuel 15:34: "And Samuel went..." to 16:13: "...in Ramah."
The Apostle, Hebrews 11:1: "Now faith is..." to verse 31: "...the spies in peace."
Alleluia: "He declares His word" (Patme zban iur).
Gospel, Luke 20:34: "And they answered..." to verse 40: "...and nothing [more]."

Friday. Tone 4 [d2]. Canticle [Harts] of Rest.
Midday Psalm 97 [98]: "They saw" (Tesin).
The Apostle, 1 Corinthians 5:9: "I wrote to you in my epistle..." to 6:10: "...shall inherit."
Alleluia: "The Lord remembered His compassion" (Yisheav ter zgtutiuns).
Gospel, Matthew 18:23: "Therefore..." to verse 35: "...their trespasses."

Saturday. Tone 3 [gk]. Of the Holy Sons and Grandsons of Saint Gregory our Enlightener: Aristakes, Vrtanes, Yusik, Grigoris, and Daniel.
Tone 4 [dk]: "True root" (Armat chshmarit).
Canticle [Harts] Tone 1 [ak]: "Who the divine light" (Or zluys astuatsayin), with its canon.
Midday [Mankunq] and Evening [Hambartsi] Tone 4 [dk]: "Divine faith" (Astuatsayin havatoy).
Midday Introit: "Of the Patriarch" (Zhayrapetakan).
Hymn Tone 3 [gk]: "Good shepherd" (Hoviv qaj).
Psalm 131 [132]: "Let Your priests" (Qahanayq qo).
Prophet Jeremiah 17:7: "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 8: "...in bearing fruit."
Prophet Isaiah 61:3: "And they shall be called..." to verse 7: "...of their heads."
The Apostle, 2 Timothy 1:6: "For which cause I remind you..." to verse 14: "...dwelling in us."
Alleluia: "Let Your priests" (Qahanayq qo).
Gospel, Luke 11:29: "And when [the crowds] were gathering..." to verse 32: "...than Jonah is here."
In the Evening: "Joyous Light" (Luys zuart).
Mesedi: "I loved, for He inclined" (Siretsi. Zi khonarhetsoyg).
Evening [Hambartsi]: "Holy art Thou, Lord" (Surb es ter).
Proclamation: "Let us ask" (Khndrestsuq). "Save" (Ketso). Prayer: "King of peace" (Tagavor khaghaghutyan).

Fifth Sunday after Vardavar [Transfiguration].
Canticle [Harts] Tone 2 [b3]: "Incorruptible" (Anapakan).
Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to You" (Qez vayel e).
Prophet Isaiah 5:1: "There was a vineyard..." to verse 10: "...three bushels."
Midday Psalm 65 [66]: "All the earth" (Amenayn erkir).
The Apostle, 1 Corinthians 6:18: "Flee fornication..." to 7:11: "...let him not leave."
Alleluia: "A great King" (Tagavor mets).
Gospel, Matthew 19:3: "And there came to Him..." to verse 12: "...let him accept it."
In the Evening: Mesedi and Evening [Hambartsi] of the Resurrection, according to the tone of the day.

Monday. Tone 1 [ak]. Of the Holy Maccabees: Eleazar the Priest, and Solomona, and her seven sons.
Canticle [Harts] Tone 3 [gd]: "Who the torments" (Orq ztanjanst).
Midday Psalm 115 [116]: "Precious is" (Patuakan e).
Proverbs 29:2: "In the praise..." to verse 7: "...discerning minds."
Book of 2 Maccabees 6:18: "Eleazar, an old man..." to 7:42: "...shall be shown."
The Apostle, Hebrews 11:32: "And what more shall I say..." to verse 40: "...should be made perfect."
Alleluia: "The salvation of the righteous" (Prkutiun ardarots).
Gospel, Matthew 5:17: "Think not..." to verse 20: "...into the kingdom of heaven."

Tuesday. Tone 2 [b3]. Of the Holy Twelve Prophets: Hosea, Amos, Micah, Joel, Obadiah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Jonah, Zephaniah, Haggai, Zechariah, and Malachi.
Song Tone 1 [ak]: "Who the divine" (Or zastuatsayin).
Canticle [Harts] Tone 4 [dz]: "Who with the earthly" (Or nd geghotsn), with its canon.
Magnificat [Metsatsustse] Tone 4 [d3]: "Who in the heights" (Or i bardzrutis).
Midday Introit: "Lord, who established" (Ter or himnetsutser).
Hymn Tone 1 [ad]: "Ray of light" (Charagayt).
Psalm 67 [68]: "In the churches" (Yekegeghetsis).
Prophet Hosea 10:11: "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 12: "...righteousness."
Prophet Amos 5:10: "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 14: "...God Almighty."
Prophet Micah 7:7: "But as for me, to the Lord..." to verse 9: "...His righteousness."
Prophet Joel 2:12: "And now, says the Lord..." to verse 13: "...over evil."
Prophet Obadiah 1:20: "Thus says the Lord, and they shall go up..." to verse 21: "...the Lord's kingdom."
Prophet Jonah 4:2: "And he prayed..."
